faces.name: Jitte and Divining Top
faces.oracleText:
Whenever equipped creature deals combat damage, put 2 charge counters on Jitte and Divining Top.
Remove a charge counter from Jitte and Divining Top: Choose one —
• You gain 2 life.
• Look at the top 3 cards of your library, then put them back in any order.
• Tap Jitte and Divining Top. If you do, draw a card, then put Jitte and Divining Top on top of its owner's library.
Equip {1}
